# 3 Sons Bar-B-Q

> Gulf Coast barbecue smoked daily at Mile Marker 1 on 30A in Santa Rosa Beach, Florida, one mile off US-98. Restaurant, full-service bar with happy hour, and pickup catering.

## Key facts
- Name: 3 Sons Bar-B-Q (barbecue restaurant, full-service bar and catering)
- Address: 6931 W County Hwy 30A, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459 (Mile Marker 1 on 30A, one mile off US-98)
- Phone: (850) 278-6082 · Email: brisket@3sonsbarbq.com
- Hours: <!--h:summary-->Every day, 11a–8p<!--/h--><!--h:noteSep--> · We stay open a little later in summer, so call to check<!--/h-->
- Holidays: <!--h:holidayFull-->Closed Thanksgiving & Christmas Day. Other holiday hours can vary, so call ahead.<!--/h-->
- Happy hour: 2p–5p daily at the bar
- Catering: pickup only, at the restaurant. Packages for 10 to 50 people from $220 plus tax and the 18% catering gratuity, or a custom order. Order online at https://3sonsbar-b-q.gethoneycart.com/ or call (850) 278-6082. Call to confirm how much notice your order needs.
- Reservations: not needed (99 seats, free parking lot, wheelchair accessible)
- Restaurant delivery (not catering): 30A Beach Bites and DoorDash
- Gift cards: https://3sonsbarbq.cardfoundry.com/
- Since 2013. 2024 & 2026 Best of the Emerald Coast (Emerald Coast Magazine; 2024 for Barbecue).

# 3 Sons Bar-B-Q | BBQ, Catering & Happy Hour in Santa Rosa Beach on 30A

Source: https://3sonsbarbq.com/

# Gulf Coast ’Q. Smoked low & slow on 30A.

Brisket, pulled pork, ribs, turkey, sausage and pulled chicken, smoked on Primitive Pits offset smokers. Smoking since 2013, now at Mile Marker 1 on 30A. Grab lunch, pull up a stool at the bar, or let us feed the whole crew.

- 2024 & 2026 Best of the Emerald Coast Emerald Coast Magazine · 2024 for Barbecue
- 172 Google reviews that bring up the brisket Google’s review topic count, read Oct 1, 2026
- Est. 2013 Now at Mile Marker 1 on 30A, one mile from US-98 Santa Rosa Beach, FL
- 99 Seats, plus our own free parking lot Groups welcome · no reservations needed

## Good to know before you come

- Plenty of free parking Our own lot, right out front.
- Wheelchair accessible Entrance, parking, restroom and seating.
- Full-service bar Happy hour 2p–5p every day. See happy hour
- Inside or out Seats inside, out on the deck, or at the bar. No reservations needed.
01 Off the pit

## Brisket is king. It’s not the only thing.

Our meat is smoked daily on our two 1,000-gallon Primitive Pits offset smokers, Buddy and Big Al, over hardwood oak. Then it goes on a plate, a wrap, a potato or a pile of Zapp’s chips.

Menu prices are cash prices. Card prices include a 3.5% non-cash adjustment.

### Brisket

The one Google reviewers keep writing about — Google tags 172 reviews with it. Plate with two sides, $23.

### Slab Wrap

Brisket on warm naan with onions, tomato, cukes and Slabziki sauce. A 3 Sons original. $17.

### Texas Twinkies

Bacon-wrapped jalapeños stuffed with cheddar, cream cheese and brisket. $14.

### Pulled Pork

Plate with two sides, $16. Or a sandwich with one side, $14.

### Zapp’s Voodoo Bowl

Zapp’s chips topped with pulled pork, cole slaw and Sweet Georgia Brown sauce. $16.

### Homemade Cornbread

Just like Grandma used to make. $5.

### Save room.

Peach cobbler à la mode, $12.

02 Right at the start of 30A

## One mile off 98. Skip the 30A traffic.

Turn off US-98 onto the west end of 30A and we’re one mile in, at Mile Marker 1. No crawling down the rest of 30A, even in July. Free parking in our own lot when you get here.

- US-98 From Destin, Panama City Beach or anywhere along 98
- Turn onto the west end of 30A
- 3 Sons Bar-B-Q One mile in, at Mile Marker 1
- The rest of 30A Dune Allen, Blue Mountain, Grayton, Rosemary, Inlet Beach — you don’t need any of it
03 Catering

## Office lunch. Birthday. Anniversary.

Local offices, birthday parties, anniversaries, family in town — we’ll feed the whole crowd. Packages for 10 to 50 people start at $220 plus tax and the 18% catering gratuity, or tell us what you want and we’ll build it with you — slab wraps, loaded potatoes, whatever the crowd wants.

# Menu | 3 Sons Bar-B-Q · Brisket, Slab Wrap & Texas Twinkies in Santa Rosa Beach

Source: https://3sonsbarbq.com/menu

The menu

# Smoked daily. Brisket is king.

We smoke our meat every day on our two 1,000-gallon Primitive Pits offset smokers, Buddy and Big Al, using hardwood oak. Order at the Q line, or belly up to the bar and order there.

GF = gluten-free

## Today’s menu

This is the menu design 3 Sons keeps on Must Have Menus. Open it full size (opens in a new tab), or read the text version below.

## The menu in text

Easy to read on a phone, with a screen reader, or for search. Menu as of August 14, 2026.

Pick your meat: brisket, ribs, pulled pork, pulled chicken, sausage or turkey.

### Mix it up

Can’t pick one meat?

## Specialties

### Slab Wrap $17

Brisket on warm naan bread topped with onions, tomato, cukes and Slabziki sauce.

### Texas Twinkies $14 GF

Three bacon-wrapped jalapeños stuffed with cheddar and cream cheeses, brisket and spices.

Takes an extra 5–7 minutes.

### Pitmaster’s Plate for Four $120

6 ribs, 1/3 lb. each of brisket, pulled pork, sausage, turkey and pulled chicken. Pints of mac & cheese, cole slaw, tater salad and beans, and two pieces of cornbread. No substitutions.

### No Sleep ’Til Brisket Burger $24

We only make a few of these each day, first come, first served. An 8 oz. brisket patty topped with 1/4 lb. of brisket and gruyère cheese on a brioche bun with lettuce, tomato, pickled onions, pickles and Peppah Rodgers sauce. Served with one side.

### Trailer Tacos $17 GF

Perfected in the original trailer. Two soft corn tortillas loaded with pulled pork, pulled chicken or brisket, fresh salsa, cole slaw and Sweet Georgia Brown sauce.

### Zapp’s Voodoo Bowl $16 GF

Zapp’s chips topped with pulled pork, cole slaw and Sweet Georgia Brown sauce.

### Brunswick Stew $9 / $16 / $30 GF

Cup, pint or quart. A closely guarded family recipe.

### Homemade Cornbread $5

Just like Grandma used to make.

03 Let us do the cooking

## Crowd pleasers.

Local offices, birthday parties, anniversaries, and families in town for the week. Packed and ready to pick up at Mile Marker 1.

### Office lunch

Feed the whole team without anyone leaving the building. The 20-person package is 10 lbs. of meat and three sides for $440 + tax and 18% gratuity.

### Birthdays & anniversaries

Up to 3 meats and 3 sides, so the picky eaters and the brisket people both win.

### Dinner for the rental

Got a beach house full of family in town? Pick up dinner for 30 at Mile Marker 1 on the way back from the beach. $660 + tax and 18% gratuity.

04 Make it yours

## Want something different?

Packages are the easy way to order. They’re not the only way. Want slab wraps for the office, loaded baked potatoes for a party, or just a few pounds of brisket? Call us and we’ll build the order with you.

### Bulk orders

We prefer 48 hours’ notice because we smoke the traditional way.

### Over 30 people

Order at least 72 hours ahead.

### Pick it up on 30A

Catering orders are picked up at the restaurant, at Mile Marker 1.

### Gratuity

Added to all catering and large to-go orders.

03 When you get here

## Bringing 10 people? Come on.

No reservations and plenty of room. Here’s what to expect, whether it’s lunch for two or the whole office.

### Parking

Park free in our own lot right out front, so there’s usually plenty of room.

### Seats

Room for 99. Big groups are welcome. Just walk in.

### Wheelchair accessible

A ramp up to the front deck, plus a wheelchair-accessible entrance, parking, restroom and seating. Need anything else? Call before you come.

### How to order

Walk through our fast-moving Q line and sit wherever you like. Or belly up to the full-service bar and order there.

### Bring the family

We have a kids’ menu for 12 and under, and high chairs if you need one.

### Taking it home?

We specialize in takeout. Come in and we’ll pack it up, or find us on 30A Beach Bites and DoorDash.

04 What to look for

## The sign. The deck. The smoke.

A white building with a red-and-white sign out front, a big wooden deck with red chairs and umbrellas, and our own lot. When the lights come on at dusk, you can’t miss it.

# FAQ | 3 Sons Bar-B-Q · Catering, Parking, Reservations & More

Source: https://3sonsbarbq.com/faq

Get answers here

# Need to know.

Still stuck? Call us at (850) 278-6082 or email brisket@3sonsbarbq.com.

Open all answers

## Do you cater?

Yes, we do! We offer catering for various events and occasions. Whether you’re hosting a corporate event, family gathering, or a special celebration, our delicious barbecue dishes will surely impress your guests.

For medium orders (10–20 people), please give us a call; preferably 24 hours in advance so we can accommodate efficiently. For larger catering orders (30 or more people), we’ll need more time; please give us a call 48 hours in advance! We will have your order packed and ready for you to pick up and feed your crowd.

See catering packages and plan an order

## Where are you located?

Our restaurant is conveniently located at Mile Marker 1 on 30A, one mile from US Hwy 98 at 6931 W. County Hwy 30A, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459. The West End is the Best End!

Directions, parking and what to expect

## What style of barbecue do you offer?

3 Sons Bar-B-Q curates “Gulf Coast ’Q”, pulling elements from Georgia, the Carolinas, Memphis to Texas; we take pride in tradition. We smoke all of our meats on off-set smokers from Primitive Pits; low and slow is the key! Our menu includes classic choices like spare ribs, pulled pork, brisket, sausage, turkey and chicken. Additionally, we offer a variety of sides and desserts to complement your barbecue feast.

See the full menu

## Do you have vegetarian or vegan options?

Riiight, we’ve been horrifying vegetarians since 2013!

But seriously, we do have our baked potato, salad and cole slaw. So your “friend” can still dine while you devour a succulent bar-b-q meal!

We offer many gluten-free options, and understand the importance of catering to different dietary preferences. Please let us know of any allergies ahead of ordering.

## Can I make a reservation for a large group?

We don’t offer reservations! When you arrive you can dine in one of two ways: Our bar is full service so feel free to belly up and enjoy. Alternatively, you’ll walk through our fast moving Q line and then sit down wherever you like. We have plenty of room for small and large groups alike!

## Do you offer takeout?

Yes, we specialize in takeout! Our service line is quick and efficient, so just come on in and we will pack up your order hot and fresh. For larger orders, please call us at (850) 278-6082 or stop in and we will have you on your way in no time.

## Do you offer delivery?

Yes, you can find us on 30A Beach Bites and DoorDash!

## What are your holiday hours?

<!--h:faqHoliday-->We are closed on Thanksgiving & Christmas Day.<!--/h--> Our operating hours on public holidays may vary. We recommend checking our website or calling us directly to confirm our hours of operation for specific holidays.

## Do you have a kids’ menu?

Yes, we have a kids’ menu designed to cater to our younger barbecue enthusiasts. Our kids’ menu features smaller portions of our popular dishes, as well as some kid-friendly favorites.

## Do you have Terms and Conditions?

Yes, click to find them here: Terms and Conditions.

Remember, if you have any further questions or need more information, don’t hesitate to reach out to our friendly staff. We look forward to serving you at 3 Sons Bar-B-Q!

## More answers: parking, accessibility & happy hour

### Is there parking?

Yes. We have our own free parking lot on site, so there’s usually plenty of room.

### Is 3 Sons wheelchair accessible?

Yes. There’s a ramp up to the front deck, and the entrance, parking lot, restroom and seating are wheelchair accessible. If you need anything else, call us before you come.

### How many people can you seat?

We have 99 seats, so groups big and small are welcome. No reservations needed.

### When is happy hour?

Happy hour runs 2p–5p every day at our full-service bar. <!--h:sentence-->We’re open 11a–8p daily.<!--/h--> See happy hour

3 Sons Bar-B-Q · 6931 W County Hwy 30A, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459 · (850) 278-6082 · brisket@3sonsbarbq.com

# Terms & Conditions, Gift Cards and Accessibility | 3 Sons Bar-B-Q

Source: https://3sonsbarbq.com/terms

The fine print.

# Terms & Conditions

Looking for our accessibility statement? Read it here.

## Privacy Policy:

### General

We are committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains what information we collect about users of our web site and describes how we will use it.

Our web site contains links to other sites which are outside our control and are not covered by this privacy policy. If you access other sites using the links provided, your information may be used by the operators of those sites in accordance with their privacy policy, which may differ from ours.

### What information do we collect?

We collect information from you when you fill out a form. When contacting us through our site, as appropriate, you may be asked to enter your: name, e-mail address, mailing address or phone number.

### What do we do with the information we collect?

Any of the information we collect from you may be used in the following ways:

- To improve customer service (your information helps us to more effectively respond to your customer service requests and support needs)
- To send periodic emails. The email address you provide may be used to send you information and updates pertaining to your inquiry, in addition to receiving occasional company news, updates, related product or service information, etc.

### Disclosures of your information

We will not sell, trade or rent information about you to others.

### What about cookies?

"Cookies" are small pieces of information that are stored on your computers hard drive by your web browser. We use cookies to maintain the items added to your shopping cart. Most browsers allow you to turn off the cookie function. If you want to know how to do this please look at the help menu on your browser. Allow your browser to accept cookies if you would like to use the functionality of this site.

### Online Privacy Policy Only

This online privacy policy applies only to information collected through our website and not to information collected offline.

### Your Consent

By using our site, you consent to our online privacy policy.

### Changes to our Privacy Policy

If we decide to change our privacy policy, we will post those changes here.

## Security Policy:

Your payment and personal information is always safe. Our Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) software is the industry standard and among the best software available today for secure commerce transactions. It encrypts all of your personal information, including credit card number, name, and address, so that it cannot be read over the internet. All pages on this website that transmit sensitive data use SSL encryption.

## Delivery Policy:

Orders placed after 2:00 PM CST will be shipped the following business day, subject to weather-related delays or other causes beyond our reasonable control.

Orders will not be shipped or delivered on Saturdays, Sundays or holidays. UPS and FedEx will not deliver to P.O. Boxes and your package will be returned to us. There is no guarantee on delivery times of untracked USPS deliveries.

## Return Policy:

All gift card sales are final. No refunds or returns.

## Contacting Us:

If you have any questions regarding these policies, you may contact us using the information below:

brisket@3sonsbarbq.com

# Accessibility | 3 Sons Bar-B-Q

Source: https://3sonsbarbq.com/accessibility

Accessibility

# Everyone’s welcome at Mile Marker 1.

We want everyone to be able to visit 3 Sons Bar-B-Q, at the restaurant and on this website, including people with disabilities.

Last reviewed October 26, 2026

## At the restaurant

- A ramp up to the front deck
- Wheelchair-accessible entrance
- Wheelchair-accessible parking in our lot
- Wheelchair-accessible restroom
- Wheelchair-accessible seating
If you need anything else to make your visit easier, call us before you come and we’ll do our best to help.

## On this website

We aim for this website to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 at Level AA. These are the guidelines most widely used to make websites work for people with disabilities, including people who use screen readers, keyboards or zoom. We review the site against them when we make design changes.

## Need help?

If any part of this website is hard to use, or you need information in a different format, call (850) 278-6082 or email brisket@3sonsbarbq.com. We’ll help you place your order or get you what you need another way. Please tell us the page and the problem so we can fix it.

## Other companies’ websites

Some things you can do from this site happen on other companies’ websites: online catering orders, gift card purchases, our menu service, delivery apps and job applications. We don’t control how those sites are built. If you have trouble with one, call us and we’ll help.
